chapter: Musicians and ragtime bands of the time
title: White ragtime bands of the era and George Schilling's drummer
summary: He lists the white ragtime bands (Christian, Gallaty, Tom Brown, Jack Laine, Johnny Fisher), and says Schilling came out of Fisher's band with drummer Freddie Williams.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Emile's brother. Emile, yeah. Frank. Bill Gallaty. Tom Brown. Jack Lane. Johnny Fisher. George Shilling was a trombone player with Johnny Fisher. Then he broke up and George Shilling went, you know, and he'd make a drum deck. And at that time, I'll tell you who was playing drum. He was a retired policeman now. Freddie Williams. Yes. Remember?
Yeah. He used to play drums with Fisher. Then he went with George Shilling. Yeah. Now that's, oh, that's 1928, 1929.
